description: Make a finished lead magnet for any business with Alex Hormozi's lead magnet method from $100M Leads (reveal a problem, a sample or trial, or one step of many; name it so people want it; end with a clear CTA). The owner answers an intake and gives their website; the output is a working, self-contained page restyled to their brand (colours, fonts, logo, button shape, measured from their site) (a scored assessment, a step-by-step guide that also prints to PDF, or a claim page for a free service) plus the post that gives it away and a plan for testing the name. Use when someone wants a lead magnet, a freebie, an opt-in, a scorecard or quiz funnel, a free audit offer, "something to give away for emails", more leads from the same traffic, or $100M Leads.
